rdfs:label: preferredUsername
rdfs:comment: The preferred short username of an actor (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service) in ActivityPub — the local part used in `@user@host` mention syntax.
notes: The handle, not the display name: `as:preferredUsername` is `alice` (used in WebFinger and `@alice@host` mentions); `as:name` is "Alice Smith" (the human-readable display string; note `urn:solid:name` is foaf:name). No case or character-set rules are imposed by ActivityPub and uniqueness is not guaranteed; servers apply their own constraints. Typically equals the local part of the Actor's WebFinger `acct:` URI.
